page_title: NAP 1-2 LAZ | Napoli v Lazio 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Ivan Provedel (Lazio) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+9' Ivan Provedel (Lazio) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

90+7' Great chance! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
90+6' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Maurizio Sarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Taty Castellanos (Lazio) replacing Ciro Immobile.
90+3' The substitution is prepared. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mattia Zaccagni.
90+3' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. Napoli will take a corner kick.

90+1' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header! The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Napoli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
88' Although Maurizio Sarri (Lazio) is just on the bench, Andrea Colombo has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
88' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Mario Rui (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
85' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
84' That will be all from Piotr Zielinski who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
83' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
81' It is time for a substitution. Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is on for Elseid Hysaj.
80' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Felipe Anderson is replaced by Pedro (Lazio).

80' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) comes onto the pitch for Matteo Politano.
75' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) picks up a long through ball, but Ivan Provedel deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
73' The goal by Lazio is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
72' The Lazio players halt their celebrations as referee Andrea Colombo makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

71' The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Alex Meret, so the score changes to 1:3.
68' Celebrations are cut short for Lazio as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
68' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the Lazio goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
67' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is released by Matteo Guendouzi, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
66' Here's the change. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia leaves the pitch and Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
66' Here is a change. Mathias Olivera is going off and Rudi Garcia gives the last tactical orders to Mario Rui (Napoli).
65' Daichi Kamada will be replaced by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio).
64' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
63' The game is interrupted now, Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Luis Alberto (Lazio) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.

59' The ball rebounded to Piotr Zielinski (Napoli), whose first-time shot from long range had the keeper scrambling but flew just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
58' The corner kick from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

57' Matteo Politano (Napoli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
56' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
52' 1 - 2 Daichi Kamada (Lazio) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
51' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:2.
48' The ball is cleared after Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the roof of the net, but Ivan Provedel gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
42' Luis Alberto (Lazio) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

40' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
40' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
37' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Napoli show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
34' Referee Andrea Colombo has finally had enough of Rudi Garcia and brandishes a yellow card at him!
32' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Ivan Provedel. He makes it 1:1.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Luis Alberto (Lazio) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
29' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky!
26' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
25' The Napoli players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
21' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Ivan Provedel (Lazio) leaps to collect the ball.

21' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Ivan Provedel sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top right corner. The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.
20' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

17' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Victor Osimhen (Napoli). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
17' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.

14' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
14' Corner kick. Napoli will have an opportunity.

13' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. Napoli win a corner.
12' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli have been awarded a free kick.

10' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Lazio, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

7' Napoli slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
4' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Napoli.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lazio will kick-off.
Andrea Colombo will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
